title: elaphrium gracile
intro: Elaphrium gracile, commonly known as Elaphium angustifolium, is a flowering plant species in the gentian family, native to North America. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Elaphium angustifolium include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include xanthones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as exhibiting antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects.
